title: Nicknames and identities among musicians
summary: Hinton and Jones talk about nicknames like Satchel Mouth and Mule Face and why musicians gave each other identities.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I'd like to just mention this if I may. Knowing Zutty Singleton, I worked for him and he was responsible for me coming into the business - you knew Zutty very well and Zutty always had a name for everything. He started with face and then whatever he thought your face was like bullet face, mule face, horse face - face was your noun and what came before it was the adjective to describe what kind of face you had. This seems to have gone down through the ethnic groups and ethnic bands and black bands. We always in the black society, we all always have nicknames. As a kid I
was called Sporty and later became Fump in Cab Calloway's band and later became The Judge which everybody calls me to this very day. So this is a part of our heritage, a nickname.

Of course. It wasn't a nickname, it was a case of identity, special identity. You know Mr. Red Allen used to always say, 'My man,' because you do not have that kind of a mentality to remember everybody's name, number, and rank. When you're traveling around the way we was traveling around - and you must remember with the various peoples, that a Zutty Singleton, or any one of us, even yourself, various peoples that we meet in traveling around throughout the world, we have to have an identity.

Pardon me, Jo, there goes the phone again. The best part of being a side man and a musician, we have to keep moving to keep from getting hit. This is such an interesting conversation I want to get back to that what you were talking about, Jo.

You must remember, Milt, I have an unusual background from carnivals, circuses, and what have you. Why we say that these peoples use these conundrums to identify different peoples, like Zutty, like Pops always said, Satchel Mouth - you know what I mean - not because he was called that, but he called everybody Satchel Mouth.
There's another guy said Mule Face.
